Package frc.robot.subsystems.shooter

Class ShooterConstants

java.lang.Object
frc.robot.subsystems.shooter.ShooterConstants
public final class ShooterConstants extends Object
Hardware constants and calibration data for the shooter mechanism.

This class groups three categories of configuration:

  • Flywheel constants â€” CAN IDs, PID gains, current limits, and error thresholds for the two shooter motors. CAN IDs are set in Stage 8.
  • Hood constants (ShooterConstants.HoodConstants) â€” CAN IDs, gear ratio, PID gains, software limits, and encoder config for the hood angle motor. CAN IDs and magnet offset set in Stage 8.
  • Calibration tables (scoringMeasurements, feedingMeasurements) â€” empirical shot data collected from Hackbots; must be re-validated in Stage 8-8 with the actual Gearcats robot.

    • kRecoveryErrorThreshold

      protected static final edu.wpi.first.units.measure.AngularVelocity kRecoveryErrorThreshold
      Speed error (RPS below target) that triggers automatic switch to recovery control mode. If the flywheel drops 8 RPS below its setpoint (e.g., after a note passes through), Shooter switches to VelocityDutyCycle to recover faster at lower current.

    • kShootingErrorDetectionThreshold

      protected static final edu.wpi.first.units.measure.AngularVelocity kShootingErrorDetectionThreshold
      Speed error (RPS) used to detect when a note has passed through the shooter. A 4 RPS dip signals a shot event for logging and recovery logic.

    • kMotorConfig

      protected static final com.ctre.phoenix6.configs.TalonFXConfiguration kMotorConfig
      TalonFX configuration applied to both flywheel motors.

      PeakReverseDutyCycle(0) prevents the motors from spinning backward, which would eject notes back into the hopper. The shooter is designed to spin in one direction only â€” all "reverse" operations are handled by reducing speed, not by reversing direction.

    • kRadius

      public static final edu.wpi.first.units.measure.Distance kRadius
      Radius of the shooter wheels, used to convert RPS to linear surface speed.

    • kReverseVelocity

      public static final edu.wpi.first.units.measure.AngularVelocity kReverseVelocity
      Flywheel speed used when reversing to unjam a note. Applied only during explicit unjam commands, not during normal shooting.

    • kMotor2Alignment

      public static final com.ctre.phoenix6.signals.MotorAlignmentValue kMotor2Alignment
      Alignment value for motor 2. MotorAlignmentValue.Aligned means motor 2 rotates in the same direction as motor 1 mechanically (before any software inversion).

    • scoringMeasurements

      public static final List<AimMeasurement> scoringMeasurements
      Empirical aim calibration table for scoring into the hub.

      Each entry maps a measured robot-to-hub distance to the hood angle, flywheel RPS, and time-of-flight that produced a successful score during Hackbots testing. The table is interpolated by ToFAim at runtime.

      Must be re-validated in Stage 8-8 â€” the Hackbots data may not transfer exactly to the Gearcats robot due to mechanical differences.

    • feedingMeasurements

      public static final List<AimMeasurement> feedingMeasurements
      Empirical aim calibration table for feeding notes to a partner robot (passing).

      Same structure as scoringMeasurements but tuned for the lower-arc trajectory used when passing. Includes a 15 m lob entry (80 RPS) for full-field passes. Also requires re-validation in Stage 8-8.
